about_the_game:
Enabling the Realistic DLC will override the Standard Mode. This mode applies more scientifically based Great Filter data and features a separate leaderboard, ideal for players seeking a serious challenge.
The DLC switches from pseudo-random to true random number generation.
Note: May not be suitable for casual players.
